title: Commuting to College: Accessibility, Cost, Emissions and Choice for Higher Education in Leinster
description:
Models weekday commutes by public transport and by car from 1,197 Electoral Divisions in 15 Leinster counties to 14 higher-education campuses, at two times of day, with the annual cost and carbon of each journey, its distribution by area deprivation and car availability, a validation against Census 2022 journeys, and a county-scale model of whether accessibility predicts where new entrants enrol.

Read the report: https://jkeatingmu.github.io/commuting-to-college/. Code, data and documentation: github.com/JKeatingMU/commuting-to-college.

Individual research and analysis by John G. Keating; not an official Maynooth University publication. This work received no funding.
